subject.title: Fallback turns can re-execute work already reported as completed (semantic recursive task execution)

question: Should maintainers accept https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92011 as a scoped embedded-runtime mitigation while keeping this issue open for the remaining gateway, scheduling, and Codex-native surfaces?
rationale: The linked PR is proof-sufficient and mergeable, but the issue asks for a cross-harness invariant and the remaining scope is a product/runtime boundary choice rather than a safe automatic cleanup decision.

options.title: Accept scoped mitigation
options.body: Merge the embedded sessions_spawn guard and keep this issue open for explicit follow-ups on gateway loopback, sessions_send/cron, and Codex-native spawn surfaces.

options.title: Harden broader policy first
options.body: Hold the linked PR until a shared fallback-completion work-spawning policy covers the remaining OpenClaw delegation tools in the same change.

options.title: Split Codex-native ownership
options.body: Land the OpenClaw-owned guard after documenting the Codex-native spawn_agent work as an upstream or separate owner follow-up.

recommendation.title: Accept scoped mitigation
recommendation.body: Merge the embedded sessions_spawn guard and keep this issue open for explicit follow-ups on gateway loopback, sessions_send/cron, and Codex-native spawn surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc authored the cross-harness review that defined the current merge-scope question and has recent completion-handoff history in the affected area.
